lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.focus: deriving ASA, SAS, and SSS from rigid motion
lessonRef.title: Unit assessment: deriving ASA, SAS, and SSS from rigid motion

sections.title: Mastery check
sections.directions: Unit assessment. Work alone, show your steps, and check your work before you finish.

items.prompt: Triangle ABC is congruent to triangle DEF. In triangle ABC, ∠A = 39° and ∠B = 51°. Find ∠F.
A rigid motion is a transformation that …
choices: preserves shape but may change size
preserves area but may change side lengths
maps every figure to a similar figure

items.prompt: In two triangles, two pairs of corresponding angles and the pair of included sides are congruent. Which congruence criterion applies?
Two triangles share two pairs of congruent sides and a pair of congruent angles that are not between those sides. Why does this fail to prove congruence?
choices: The angle must be a right angle for any criterion to apply.
Two sides are never enough information under any circumstances.
The unknown side can close the triangle in two different ways, producing one acute and one obtuse triangle from the same measurements.
The triangles are congruent, but the criterion is simply named differently.

items.prompt: Triangle ABC is congruent to triangle DEF. In triangle ABC, ∠A = 33° and ∠B = 57°. Find ∠F.
Two figures are congruent if and only if …
choices: there is a sequence of rigid motions taking one exactly onto the other
they can be scaled to match

items.prompt: In two triangles, two pairs of corresponding angles and a pair of non-included sides are congruent. Which congruence criterion applies?
If a sequence of rigid motions maps △ABC onto △DEF, then …
choices: the triangles have equal area but need not be congruent
only the corresponding sides are congruent
only the corresponding angles are congruent
every pair of corresponding sides and angles is congruent

items.prompt: Triangle ABC is congruent to triangle DEF. In triangle ABC, ∠A = 62° and ∠B = 29°. Find ∠F.
In two triangles, the hypotenuses and one pair of legs of two right triangles are congruent. Which congruence criterion applies?
In two triangles, all three pairs of corresponding sides are congruent. Which congruence criterion applies?
In two triangles, two pairs of corresponding sides and the pair of included angles are congruent. Which congruence criterion applies?
